rila.join_source: RILA Supplement 1 Concordance museographique, Musee archeologique de La Canee row
rila.note: RILA Supplement 1 records this join in the Khania roundel series. No reading and no glyph layer are entered: RILA Supplement 1 carries no plates and we hold no facsimile of the joined object. The component records stay, so this object appears under two id schemes, which is the join-variant duplicate-row problem that HT 123a and HT 123+124a already show.

text_missing_reason: No reading is entered for the joined object. RILA Supplement 1 lists the join, and each part has its own record: KH Wc 2059, KH Wc 2091, KH Wc 2092. The gap is in our sources, not on the object.
